title: REQ · Loader valid, invalid and missing-asset fallback paths are proven with fs mocked
summary: Mocked-fs tests for loadManifestFile and loadManifestWithFallback
description: With readFileSync and existsSync mocked, loadManifestFile and loadManifestWithFallback must be shown to return ok for a valid manifest, parse errors for a schema-invalid manifest, a 'cannot read manifest' error for an unreadable or malformed file, and a filtered manifest plus missing list when asset files are absent.
acceptance_criteria: Given a valid manifest and existsSync true, then loadManifestFile returns ok true
Given a schema-invalid manifest, then loadManifestFile returns ok false and the fallback returns an empty manifest with errors
Given existsSync false for one asset, then the fallback lists it in missing and keeps the others
definition_of_done: All paths asserted with mocked fs
